Homemade crispy onion rings >> 😋🧅🔥 FULL RECIPE ⬇️ Ingredients: Large yellow onion All-purpose flour Cornstarch Garlic and herb breadcrumbs Sparkling water Vegetable oil Mayonnaise Ketchup Worcestershire sauce Seasonings: Salt Black pepper Garlic powder Smoked paprika Cayenne pepper Instructions: Peel the onion and slice it into ½-inch thick rounds. Gently separate the slices into rings, removing the thin inner membrane from each ring to keep the texture tender. Place the onion rings in a bowl of ice-cold water and let them soak for 15 minutes. This helps reduce their sharpness and improves the final crispiness. Once soaked, drain and pat dry completely. While the onion rings are soaking, prepare the dipping sauce by combining ½ cup of mayonnaise, 2 tablespoons of ketchup, a small splash (about ½ teaspoon) of Worcestershire sauce, and ½ teaspoon each of salt, black pepper, and smoked paprika in a small bowl. Stir until smooth and well blended, then cover and refrigerate until ready to serve. To make the batter, whisk together 2 cups of all-purpose flour, ⅓ cup of cornstarch, and 1 teaspoon each of salt, black pepper, garlic powder, smoked paprika, and cayenne pepper in a mixing bowl. Slowly pour in 1 ½ cups of sparkling water, stirring until a smooth batter forms. Adjust the consistency with a little more sparkling water if needed, aiming for a slightly thick but pourable texture. Pour about 2 cups of garlic and herb breadcrumbs into a separate bowl, and set up a dredging station with a bowl of plain flour, the batter, and the breadcrumbs arranged in order. Coat each onion ring by first lightly dredging it in flour, then dipping it into the batter, and finally pressing it into the breadcrumbs until fully coated. Place each coated ring on a wire rack and let them rest while you finish coating the rest. Heat vegetable oil in a pan over medium heat. Once hot, carefully add the onion rings in batches and fry them for 5-6 minutes or until they are golden brown and crispy. Remove the onion rings from the oil and place them on a wire rack to drain any excess oil. Serve them hot with the chilled dipping sauce on the side and enjoy a perfectly crispy, flavorful snack. #fyp #cookwithme #onionrings #easyrecipe #foodie

No bake key lime cheesecake cups… and yes, they’re as good as they look, but even easier to make I used the mini cups I posted earlier today I’ll link them in the comments. This makes about 8 cheesecake cups. Ingredients Crust 	•	1 package cinnamon graham crackers (not the whole box) 	•	½ stick butter, melted Cheesecake filling 	•	1 tub Pillsbury no bake cheesecake 	•	1/3 cup lime juice 	•	Zest of 5 key limes Optional topping (highly recommend) 	•	1 package cream cheese, softened 	•	1/3 cup brown sugar 	•	1 tbsp vanilla 	•	1 small tub Cool Whip Method Crush graham crackers and mix with melted butter. Press into the bottom of your cups. Whitogether the cheesecake mix, lime juice, and zest, then spoon over the crust. You can stop there and sprinkle more crust on top… or make the topping. For the topping, whip everything together until smooth, layer it on, then finish with more crust.  Refrigerate for an hour (24 if you can wait) before serving.  No bake… stupid easy, and that topping takes it to a whole different level, save this and share it with your friends for the best spring/summer dessert.

Lay the tortillas around the edges of a sheet pan so the centers sit on the lip of the pan, then place one tortilla flat in the middle. Spread about ¾ cup sour cream across the tortillas. 2.	In a skillet, cook the ground beef with taco seasoning and beef broth until browned and the liquid is absorbed. Optional: For extra flavor, add 1 diced onion and 6 cloves of minced garlic. 3.	Add the beef over the sour cream, then layer shredded cheese, tostadas, shredded lettuce, and diced tomatoes. 4.	Add a tortilla with sour cream in the middle. Fold the tortillas over the top to fully enclose everything, then brush with melted butter. 5.	Top with another baking sheet and bake at 420°F for 20 minutes. Throwback to this Honey Garlic Lemon Pepper Chicken Thighs recipe. The full recipe is posted below and can also be found in my cookbook Let’s Get Into It! Check out my cookbook through the link in my bio. Notes: If you are doubling the recipe, do not add more lemon slices to the sauce as it will become too bitter. Ingredients: •4 bone-in Chicken Thighs •2 tsp Lemon Pepper Seasoning •2 tsp Garlic Powder •2 tsp Smoked Paprika •1 tsp Kosher Salt •1 tsp Black Pepper •1 tsp Onion Powder •3 tbsp Olive Oil Sauce •2 tbsp Unsalted Butter •¼ cup Honey •4 slices of Lemon •4 tsp minced garlic •1 tbsp freshly squeezed Lemon Juice •2 tsp Low-Sodium Soy Sauce Instructions: Prepare the Chicken 1. Clean and pat the thighs dry. In a small bowl, combine the lemon pepper seasoning, garlic powder, paprika, salt, black pepper, and onion powder. Stir in the olive oil to make a seasoning paste. Fully coat the thighs with the paste, spreading it underneath the thigh skin to flavor the meat. Transfer the chicken to a zip-top bag or a container with a lid. Let the thighs marinate for at least 2 hours or up to overnight. 2. When the chicken is done marinating, preheat the oven to 425°F (215°C). Line a large baking pan or 9x13-inch (23x33cm) baking pan with foil, set a baking rack in the pan, and coat the baking rack with nonstick cooking spray. 3. Place the thighs on the rack skin side down. Bake, uncovered. for 30 minutes. Turn over the thighs and continue to bake for 20 to 25 minutes, until cooked through. The internal temperature should be at least 165°F (75°C). When cutting into the chicken near the thickest section, all of the juices should run clear. While the chicken is baking we can prepare the sauce. Prepare the Sauce 4. In a large skillet over medium-low heat, melt the butter. When the butter is melted, add the honey, lemon slices, garlic, lemon juice, soy sauce, and 1 tablespoon water. Bring the sauce to a simmer, then cook, periodically stirring the sauce until it thickens, about 5 minutes. 5. When the chicken is done, brush the sauce all over both sides and bake for an additional 5 minutes, until the sauce has browned and turned sticky. Allow the thighs to cool for 3 to 5 minutes, then enjoy! #royaleeats

Slow Cooker French Onion Chicken Golden, crispy chicken thighs simmered in a rich, caramelized onion gravy—this dish is pure comfort with barely any effort. It’s cozy, flavorful, and perfect for busy days when you want something truly satisfying. 🛒 Ingredients (Serves 4–6) For the chicken: 6 bone-in, skin-on chicken thighs 1 tsp salt 1/2 tsp black pepper 1 tsp paprika 1 tbsp olive oil For the onion gravy: 2 large yellow onions, thinly sliced 3 cloves garlic, minced 1 cup beef broth 1 tbsp Worcestershire sauce 1 tsp dried thyme 1/2 tsp salt 1/2 tsp black pepper 👩‍🍳 Instructions Season the chicken Pat chicken dry and season with salt, pepper, and paprika. Sear for flavor Heat olive oil in a skillet over medium-high heat. Sear chicken skin-side down for 4–5 minutes until golden and crispy. Flip and cook 2 more minutes. Layer the slow cooker Add sliced onions and garlic to the bottom. Place chicken on top. Add the sauce Mix broth, Worcestershire sauce, thyme, salt, and pepper. Pour over everything. Slow cook Cover and cook on LOW for 6–7 hours or HIGH for 3–4 hours until tender. Serve Spoon the rich onion gravy over the chicken and garnish with fresh parsley if desired. 🍽️ Serving Suggestions Serve over mashed potatoes or buttered noodles Pair with rice or crusty bread to soak up the sauce Add green beans or a fresh salad for balance

Season with 1 tbsp avocado oil Red pepper flakes  Salt Garlic powder  Paprika  Mix well then spread on baking sheet and cook on 400 for about 25 mins flipping halfway though.  Into pan add 1 lb ground beef and brown.  Once browned add 2 tbsp tomato paste mix into well an then add 3/4 taco seasoning packet and 1/4 cup water. Drizzle some Japanese bbq sauce  When done set aside and into the same pan add 1 white or yellow onion sliced an 2 red bell peppers sliced with 1 tbsp oil.  Once sautéed add the rest of the taco seasoning to the veggies and a little water. And cook until liquid is gone.  Guac:  Take 1-2 avocados and mash into bowl I added some dice Roma tomato asnd 1 tbsp cilantro chopped and salt & pepper to taste.  I played my food in this order,  Sweet potato, beef, fajitas, Guac in middle then a scoop of sour cream or Greek yogurt. Garnish with cilantro or parsley and chili pepper flakes. Drizzle honey. Serve & enjoy 😊

Recipe 👇🏼 The cake: 85 g unsalted butter softened (6 tbsp) 220 g granulated sugar (about 1 cup + 2 tbsp) 120 g sourdough discard 1 large egg 1 tsp vanilla extract 60 g buttermilk (¼ cup milk + splash lemon juice) 115 g all purpose flour (¾ cup + 2 tbsp) 1 tsp baking powder ¾ tsp salt 1 lb strawberries sliced 2 tbsp sugar (for topping) The Whippe Cream: 1/2 cup Heavy whipping cream 2 tsp sugar dash vanilla Instructions: -Preheat the oven to 375 and grease a 9 inch springform pan. -Cream together the butter and sugar until light and fluffy. -Add the sourdough discard and mix until combined. -Add the egg and vanilla and mix again. -Add the buttermilk and mix until smooth and creamy. -Mix together the flour, baking powder, and salt. -Add the dry ingredients to the wet and mix until fully combined. -Spread the batter into the prepared pan. -Top with sliced strawberries, packing them in close. -Sprinkle sugar over the top. -Bake 5 minutes at 375. -Reduce heat to 325 and bake 50 to 55 minutes until set. -Whip the cream with sugar and vanilla until medium peaks form. -Serve with fresh whipped cream. I wouldn’t eat this *hot*, but warm-cold HELL YES! Store this baby in the fridge. #sourdough #tutorial #recipe #strawberrycake #foodie
